description: Deterministically resolve a source and target folder and move every video from the source into the target in one call. Pass target_folder_ref='root' to move to the root (no folder). Skips videos already being deleted. Free action (no credits). dry_run=true (default) returns a preview of which videos would move.

idempotency_key.description: Reserved client-supplied key to make retries safe (not yet enforced server-side)

source_folder_ref.description: Source folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

target_folder_ref.description: Target folder name, ID, or dashboard URL — or 'root' to move to the root (no folder)

name: panda_action_move_videos_by_folder
title: Move Videos Between Folders
